meta.title: Eusse World — International logistics, sourcing and distribution
meta.description: We connect markets across Colombia, Costa Rica, Nicaragua and the United States: international freight, imports, overseas purchasing, warehousing and last-mile delivery.

hero.lead: Freight, imports, overseas purchasing and distribution across Colombia, Costa Rica, Nicaragua and the United States, coordinated by a single team.

advisor.title: An advisor for your route

about.title: We don't just move goods.
about.body: At EUSSE WORLD we grow businesses, connect opportunities and build relationships of trust. We coordinate every leg of the chain so your goods arrive on time and your operation keeps moving.

services.title: The whole chain, one operation.
services.lead: From purchase at origin to final delivery. We coordinate every leg so your goods arrive on time and your business keeps moving.

transport.title: International freight
transport.description: Air, ocean and land cargo coordinated from origin to destination, tracked at every leg.

features.f3: One team along the whole route

trade.title: Imports and exports
trade.description: Documentation, tariff classification and customs support in every country along the route.

personalShopper.title: International purchasing
personalShopper.description: We buy abroad on your behalf: we vet suppliers, consolidate orders and ship them to your destination.

sourcing.title: Commercial sourcing
sourcing.description: Product and supplier search to keep your inventory steady and competitive.

warehousing.title: Warehousing and distribution
warehousing.description: Receiving, storage, inventory control and dispatch matched to your operation's demand.

lastMile.title: Last mile and business logistics
lastMile.description: Final delivery to customers and points of sale, and design of your company's supply chain.

custom.title: Does your operation need several services?
custom.description: We combine them into a single proposal for your route, with the same team from start to finish.

shopper.title: What you buy abroad, checked piece by piece.
shopper.lead: We buy on your behalf from stores and suppliers in the United States, check every garment and ship it consolidated to your destination.
shopper.caption: Hover along the rail, drag a hanger or open a garment to see the back.

hoodie.description: Seasonal pieces bought at the right time and shipped in time to sell.

knit.name: Knit sweater
knit.description: Delicate knits: we photograph every piece on arrival so you can approve it before shipping.

jacket.description: Workwear for companies: we consolidate several sizes and suppliers into one shipment.

sweat.name: Sweatshirt
sweat.description: Full collections: we buy every size and colour of a reference.

network.title: Four countries. One team.
network.lead: We work with partners and our own processes in every market, so we can move cargo in both directions without losing control.

process.title: From origin to destination, in four steps.
process.lead: Every operation follows the same method: you know which stage your goods are in and what you get at each one.

quote.title: Assessment and quote
quote.description: We define origin, destination, cargo type and delivery times.

purchase.title: Purchasing and consolidation
purchase.description: We buy, receive and consolidate your goods at origin.

transit.title: Freight and customs
transit.description: We move the cargo and handle customs clearance at destination.

delivery.title: Delivery and distribution
delivery.description: We store and deliver to the final point, all the way to the last mile.

planner.title: Design your shipment in seconds.
planner.lead: Choose where your goods leave from and where they are going. We coordinate everything in between.
planner.note: No commitment: an advisor reviews your route and replies with a proposal.

contact.title: Let's talk about your next shipment.
contact.lead: Tell us what you need to move, buy or store. An advisor will reply with a proposal for your route.
